[Siphon Torment](/Feats.aspx?ID=5377) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Minotaur" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=788" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 44

</column>

---

Your progenitors suffered greatly at the hands of a curse, a fate you willingly take upon yourself rather than let fall upon others. Once per day, you can cast [_claim curse_](/Spells.aspx?ID=884) as an innate divine spell. When you do, the target creature gains temporary Hit Points equal to your level.
name: Siphon Torment
